- Tue: 10:30, 13:00, 13:30, 14:30, 16:30
- Wed: 12:30, 15:00, 15:30
- Thu: 09:00, 10:00, 13:00, 14:30
- Fri: 11:00, 11:30, 13:00, 14:00

**Marcus Hale's Free Slots (30-min intervals):**
- Mon: 09:00, 09:30, 11:00, 15:00
- Tue: 11:00, 13:00, 13:30, 15:30, 16:30
- Wed: 09:00, 12:00, 14:00, 15:00, 15:30

**Common Available Slots:**

- Tue: 13:00, 13:30, 16:30

- Fri: 11:00, 11:30

Now, I will post this list of available slots to the workspace for Brad. This will allow him to check these times against the calendars of Elena Soto and David Okafor. I will be clear and concise in my message.
